affordances.name: Coding Waboose Typed Review Lessons
affordances.description: Normalizes CodeRabbit, Codex, and manual review evidence into typed bounded findings; replays durable defect lessons through Crucible; and supplies conservative source-shape focus to Coding Waboose.
affordances.when_to_use: When a coding run should reuse grounded defect classes from prior CodeRabbit, Codex, or manual reviews; normalize external PR findings; or replay adversarial review lessons before Forge handoff.
affordances.when_not_to_use: Do not use review lessons as source truth, patch authority, proof that a defect exists, or permission to fix, commit, push, open a pull request, merge, or mutate production.
affordances.safety: Review-learning and verification focus only. External reviewers are teacher signals, not authorities. All findings require exact-source corroboration, verifiers, and human review.
affordances.prompt_card: Use typed Coding Waboose review lessons to replay known defect classes and focus exact-source investigation before requesting a separately authorized Forge repair.
